findings.highlight: You’ll regret your action a bit if I kill them
findings.evidenceJa: 二人を殺してくれば、シロウも少しは後悔する
findings.governingReading: Illya says killing Saber and Rin will make Shirou regret his refusal.
findings.explanation: Your action explicitly assigns the regret to an action by Shirou rather than to Illya’s retaliatory murders.

findings.highlight: Illya will probably manage that easily
findings.evidenceJa: 容易く成し得てしまうだろう
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends after Shirou recognizes that Illya is seriously going to kill Saber and Rin; the sentence asserting she can do so easily is commented out.
findings.explanation: The English restores deleted narration and pre-judges the threatened fight’s ease.

findings.evidenceJa: ひどく愉しそうな顔
findings.governingReading: Illya answers with a face showing intense, disturbing enjoyment at having killed a Master.
findings.explanation: Cheerful normalizes her pleasure and weakens the fusion of childlike brightness with cruelty.

findings.evidenceJa: 事の次第が飲み込めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou suddenly understands the course of events.
findings.explanation: Taking is a visible typo for talking and interrupts the realization.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤおまえ
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins an appalled address to Illya.
findings.explanation: Illya and you are fused.

findings.evidenceJa: 脅しや駆け引き
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes Illya does not know how to bluff, threaten, or engage in strategic maneuvering.
findings.explanation: Haggling narrows interpersonal or tactical maneuvering to bargaining over terms or price.

findings.evidenceJa: くこの
findings.governingReading: Shirou strains against the ropes with a broken curse.
findings.explanation: Kuh and damn are fused without punctuation or spacing.

findings.evidenceJa: 鉛のように重く
findings.governingReading: Although Shirou can move his limbs, they are heavy as lead.
findings.explanation: Steel replaces lead, losing the source’s exact material and the conventional image of dense, dead weight.

findings.evidenceJa: 呪文もなしの
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines Rin mocking him for being bound by a suggestion-like paralysis that Illya imposed without an incantation.
findings.explanation: The English construction makes Shirou sound like the person who failed to cast a spell.

findings.evidenceJa: 解呪する方法
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that there is a way to dispel the magical restraint.
findings.explanation: Dispel myself makes Shirou himself the thing to be removed.

findings.highlight: magical energy is not rooted in my body
findings.evidenceJa: 体内に根付いた呪詛になっていない魔力
findings.governingReading: The rough flushing method requires that the invading energy has not become a curse rooted inside his body.
findings.explanation: The English omits the curse category and treats mere rooted magical energy as the condition.

findings.highlight: drive in a nerve into my back
findings.evidenceJa: 異なる神経を打ち込む
findings.governingReading: His former daily ritual drove a separate or different nerve into his back.
findings.explanation: The English omits different, weakening the contrast with switching existing nerves into Circuits.

findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中にあるスイッチ
findings.governingReading: The newly understood switch is located in Shirou’s mind or head.
findings.explanation: Inside of me generalizes its location to anywhere in his body.

findings.evidenceJa: 自らを暗示する言葉
findings.governingReading: The incantation is language of self-suggestion directed at the acting self.
findings.explanation: Suggest myself is malformed and can mean proposing himself rather than placing himself under suggestion.

findings.highlight: Spells do not do anything to the world
findings.evidenceJa: 呪文は世界に働きかけるものではない
findings.governingReading: The spell is not addressed directly to the world; it is addressed to the self who acts upon the world.
findings.explanation: Do not do anything to the world overstates the claim and severs the indirect causal relation explained by the next sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 自己の変革
findings.governingReading: For a magus, words most readily prompt transformation of the self.
findings.explanation: Body narrows self-transformation to physical change and shifts the general explanation into second person.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけの神秘
findings.governingReading: The command enables the magus to perform a Mystery particular to the self.
findings.explanation: Divine adds godliness and again erases the work’s technical Mystery terminology.

findings.highlight: a very simple magic called spell
findings.evidenceJa: 呪文と呼ばれる最初の魔術
findings.governingReading: A self-effective command is the first or most foundational Magecraft called an incantation or spell.
findings.explanation: Very simple replaces foundational first, magic collapses Magecraft, and called spell produces an ungrammatical definition.

findings.evidenceJa: こんな短時間で出来る
findings.governingReading: The jewel appears to let Shirou generate magical energy in a much shorter time than the usual hour.
findings.explanation: An instant removes the comparative uncertainty and asserts zero meaningful duration.

findings.evidenceJa: 手を離すだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou needs only to let go of the imagined spinning cord and release the circulating energy.
findings.explanation: Let my hands go makes his hands the released object and obscures the physical image.

findings.highlight: might go away the next time
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒後にはなくなっている可能性
findings.governingReading: The unknown healing may cease to exist even one second later.
findings.explanation: Next time removes the immediate temporal danger that makes reliance irrational.

findings.evidenceJa: 血が止まるほど締められていた訳でもない
findings.governingReading: The ropes bruised his wrists but were not tight enough to stop blood flow.
findings.explanation: The English removes the concrete circulation threshold and shifts wrists to hands.

findings.highlight: my wrists would have been twisted off smashed to pieces
findings.evidenceJa: 手首なんてヘシ折られてる
findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Berserker would have snapped his wrists while tightening the ropes.
findings.explanation: Two incompatible renderings are printed consecutively without a conjunction.

findings.evidenceJa: 軽口を叩きつつ
findings.governingReading: Shirou makes a light joke as he stands.
findings.explanation: Stupid remark replaces coping levity with a negative judgment of his intelligence.

findings.highlight: it seems the movement was too violent
findings.evidenceJa: やはり乱暴すぎたらしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes his brute-force magical purge was too rough on his body.
findings.explanation: The movement reassigns the damage to standing up rather than the dangerous internal procedure.

findings.evidenceJa: 手足の末端は感覚がない
findings.governingReading: The extremities of Shirou’s hands and feet have lost sensation.
findings.explanation: Whole limbs broadens the numb area, while senseless is poor medical English.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to get back home before Illya like this
findings.evidenceJa: 出来やしない
findings.governingReading: In this condition Shirou cannot possibly reach home before Illya.
findings.explanation: The English omits closing punctuation and leaves the urgent conclusion visibly unfinished.
